name: Evernote
tagline: Find and write notes, notebooks and tasks in your Evernote.
summary: Search, read and write the user's Evernote: notes, notebooks, tags, tasks and attachments. Existing notes and tasks are edited, moved or deleted only after the user approves.
can: Search your notes by words or by meaning, and read them with their attachments
Write new notes and tasks, and add notebooks and tags
Edit, move or delete an existing note or task, only after you approve it
